`SearchPage.svelte` owns the shortcut and input reference. Its `shortcut` handler at line 110 already focuses the bound search input for `/`, and clears it on Escape. `<svelte:window onkeydown={shortcut}>` at line 139 registers and removes the listener with the component lifecycle.

The minimal integration belongs in that handler. Add a branch for `event.key.toLowerCase() === "k"` using Meta on Mac and Control elsewhere, reject Alt/Shift and composition, call `preventDefault()`, then `input.focus()`. Unlike `/`, this modifier shortcut should work while another input or the threshold slider has focus. Keep `/` and Escape behavior intact. The visible hint at line 188 currently shows `/`; update it to the platform shortcut if desired.

`App.svelte` reads the initial path and mounts `SearchPage` only on the search route. Detail routes mount `EntityDetails`, so a handler inside `SearchPage` naturally applies only where the search input exists. There is no global shortcut utility or platform detection already in the frontend.

Verification can use `frontend/tests/search.spec.ts`, which already exercises `/`, focused input, Escape clearing, and responsive layout. Add browser checks for both platform branches, focus transfer from the slider, preserved query value, and ignored modifier/composition combinations. Platform can be set with `page.addInitScript` before navigation. Existing tests mock `/api/search`, so no database is required.

Run `npm run check`, `npm run build`, and `npm test -- tests/search.spec.ts` in `frontend`. Playwright starts Vite on port 4173. The project requires desktop screenshots from the running final UI if a PR is created.
